<function=python>

# Player at rows 17-19, cols 57-60
# Target at rows 59-60, cols 18-19
# Move LEFT and DOWN to reach target

# Move LEFT 20 steps to get closer to target column
for i in range(20):
    result = action(['LEFT'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
orange = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O']
targets = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] == 3]
if orange:
    n = orange[0]
    rows = sorted([b[0] for b in n['boundary']])
    cols = sorted([b[1] for b in n['boundary']])
    print(f"After 20 LEFT: Player rows {rows[0]}-{rows[-1]}, cols {cols[0]}-{cols[-1]}")
if targets:
    n = targets[0]
    rows = sorted([b[0] for b in n['boundary']])
    cols = sorted([b[1] for b in n['boundary']])
    print(f"Target rows {rows[0]}-{rows[-1]}, cols {cols[0]}-{cols[-1]}")

# Now move DOWN to reach target
for i in range(20):
    result = action(['DOWN'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
orange = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O']
targets = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] == 3]
if orange:
    n = orange[0]
    rows = sorted([b[0] for b in n['boundary']])
    cols = sorted([b[1] for b in n['boundary']])
    print(f"After 20 DOWN: Player rows {rows[0]}-{rows[-1]}, cols {cols[0]}-{cols[-1]}")
if targets:
    n = targets[0]
    rows = sorted([b[0] for b in n['boundary']])
    cols = sorted([b[1] for b in n['boundary']])
    print(f"Target rows {rows[0]}-{rows[-1]}, cols {cols[0]}-{cols[-1]}")

red_squares = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'R')
print(f"Red squares: {red_squares}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
